name: codex
prompt_suffix: Before declaring COMPLETE: run the experiment end to end with the frozen eval, and write results/latest.json exactly as the project instructions specify ({"metric": ..., "value": ..., "seed": ..., "split": "val"}) from THIS run. If the idea did not beat the current best (see experiments/ledger.json), report STATUS: INCOMPLETE with the number in NOTES rather than tuning on the validation set until it does. Never weaken or skip tests. Change only what the issue's **Scope:** line lists (imports, tests and new helpers in those files are fine). If a change outside it is unavoidable, add a SCOPE_NOTES: section to your result block with one line per change: `- path::component: why`.
